Tests batch bytes extraction with per-input config (extract_batch)

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var result = Xberg.extractBatch(java.util.Arrays.asList(JsonUtil.fromJson("{\"bytes\":\"pdf/fake_memo.pdf\",\"config\":{\"output_format\":\"markdown\"},\"filename\":\"fake_memo.pdf\",\"kind\":\"bytes\"}", ExtractInput.class)), ExtractionConfig.builder().build());
        System.out.println(result.results().get(0).mimeType());
        System.out.println(result.results().get(0).content());
        System.out.println(result.results().get(0).metadata().outputFormat());
    }
}
```
